cohort: 47 patients who underwent Caesarean hysterectomies for PAS by a single surgeon over a 16-year period
finding: The described surgical approach for PAS involving a midline skin incision, high midline hysterotomy, a rapid single-layer uterine closure with no placental removal attempt, constant cephalad uterine traction, and liberal choice of subtotal hysterectomy was associated with a low complication rate, with a mean estimated blood loss of 1416 ± 699 mL, mean operative time of 112 ± 49 minutes, blood transfusion requirement in 34.0% of patients, and ICU admission in 8.5% of patients.
